title: Which specific modes of exercise training are most effective for breast related cancer fatigue? Network meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: Pairwise random effects meta-analysis was performed to compare different exercise treatments.
answer.k_quote: Selection criteria were applied to include or exclude studies, resulting in the inclusion of 65 articles for comparison of the effects of 12 distinct exercise interventions on individuals with breast cancer.
